LESSON: INTERPRETING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1.3: Interpreting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Interpreting. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. interpret weather charts correctly
2. communicate weather messages accurately
3. develop interest in interpreting and communicating weather messages

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. interpret weather charts correctly
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to interpret weather charts correctly. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. communicate weather messages accurately
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to communicate weather messages accurately. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. develop interest in interpreting and communicating weather messages
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop interest in interpreting and communicating weather messages. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Interpreting.
2. Explain Interpreting to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Interpreting.
4. Show that you can: interpret weather charts correctly
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Interpreting. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Interpreting important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. interpret weather charts correctly
2. communicate weather messages accurately
3. develop interest in interpreting and communicating weather messages

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
